ayahs.1: We have given you, O Prophet, al-Kawthar—abundant good in this life and the next: honour, a lasting legacy, intercession, and a river in Paradise that those who mocked you will never reach.
ayahs.2: So establish salah for your Lord alone, and offer sacrifice—public worship and tangible gratitude that show who truly owns your time and loyalty.
ayahs.3: It is your enemy who is truly cut off—severed from lasting good, from remembrance, and from the reward he assumed his mockery could erase.
